headline: Zul'Gurub in 37:30 with no boss deaths

mvp.headline: 75 dispels, the most in the raid by 30
why: 75 dispels, ahead of Palastino (45) and Gallahan (27)
Fifth of the healers or better on Jeklik, Venoxis and Mandokir
No deaths, on a night with no boss deaths at all

also.text: most damage on Mandokir (59k) and Hakkar (77k), and 3 Delusions removed on Jin'do
most damage on Mar'li (40k) and Thekal (57k)
tanked, most damage on Arlokk, and took all five of Hakkar's mind controls without anyone dying

overview: 8 bosses in 37:30, nine minutes under the usual night (46:37). No boss deaths and no wipes. The only deaths were three healers, Künigünde, Taurenlover and Yuleblessing, to a Gurubashi Bat Rider's Unstable Concoction on the trash at the start.
Warcraft Logs wouldn't hand out parses for this run, so there are none on the pages. The afternoon ZG the same day, a mostly non-guild group with Eduard, is on its own page as a separate raid.

wentWell.text: Hakkar in 1:57 (median 2:12) with no deaths. Corrupted Blood at 1.9 per raider against a usual 2.2.
Thekal in 1:12 (median 1:33), both Great Heals interrupted.

notes.text: 1:20 (median 1:19), no deaths. Cokedog got the Gaze twice and survived both.
All five of Hakkar's mind controls went on Macharius.
